Wording: "highlights" in Russian.

- The Russian interface now calls a marked passage «хайлайт» instead of «выписка», and the managed section heading in Russian notes is «## Хайлайты из Beresta». Notes written by earlier versions under the old heading are recognised and move to the new heading on the next sync, with your own text around them untouched. English wording does not change.
- Data format description updated (an author alias added in advance is a valid tombstone). No changes to how notes are written.

Install by hand: put `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css` into `<vault>/.obsidian/plugins/beresta/` and enable the plugin in settings.
